detail.title: Landscape report
detail.polling: The report is still running. This stored status will refresh automatically.
detail.partial: {{usable}} of {{requested}} competitors produced usable data. {{failed}} source steps failed; missing values were not inferred.
detail.keywordsDescription: Ranks and URLs are observed facts. Search volume is a provider estimate; classes and recommendations are derived.
detail.sourcesDescription: Provider, cache, status, and observation dates are retained with this immutable report.

detail.acceptDescription: Acceptance creates one durable Next Action. Sending the same decision again will not create a duplicate.
